result.explanation: Atomic guarded batches are evaluated against the current register state. Invalid structure/value checks precede version, guard conflicts, and capacity; only a successful changed candidate increments the version.
result.mapping: Registers map to values, the shared capacity bounds candidate totals, and the version identifies the exact state against which a batch was requested.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated JSON and numeric limits. State is supplied only from prior calls for the same instance.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;var c=input.config,v=Object.assign({},c.initial),n=0;if(!output.length)return true;for(var i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){var e=input.events[i],g=e.guards||{},u=e.updates||{},bad=false,k;for(k in g)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(v,k))bad=true;for(k in u)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(g,k)||!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(v,k)||u[k]<0)bad=true;var s='invalid',nv=v,chg=[];if(!bad){if(e.version!==n)s='stale';else{for(k in g)if(v[k]!==g[k])s='conflict';if(s!=='conflict'){nv=Object.assign({},v);for(k in u)nv[k]=u[k];var sum=0;for(k in nv)sum+=nv[k];if(sum>c.capacity)s='capacity';else{for(k in nv)if(nv[k]!==v[k])chg.push(k);chg.sort();s=chg.length?'committed':'unchanged';if(s==='committed'){v=nv;n++}}}}}var z={status:s,version:n,values:Object.assign({},v),changed:s==='committed'?chg:[]};if(JSON.stringify(z)!==JSON.stringify(output[i]))return false}return true}
result.program: function solve(x){var st=x.state,e=x.event,c=x.config;if(st===null){st={v:Object.assign({},c.initial),n:0,cap:c.capacity}}var v=st.v,n=st.n,g=e.guards||{},u=e.updates||{},bad=false,k;for(k in g)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(v,k))bad=true;for(k in u)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(g,k)||!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(v,k)||u[k]<0)bad=true;var status,changed=[];if(bad)status='invalid';else if(e.version!==n)status='stale';else{for(k in g)if(v[k]!==g[k])status='conflict';if(!status){var nv=Object.assign({},v);for(k in u)nv[k]=u[k];var sum=0;for(k in nv)sum+=nv[k];if(sum>st.cap)status='capacity';else{for(k in nv)if(nv[k]!==v[k])changed.push(k);changed.sort();if(changed.length){v=nv;n++;status='committed'}else status='unchanged'}}}return{state:{v:v,n:n,cap:st.cap},output:{status:status,version:n,values:Object.assign({},v),changed:status==='committed'?changed:[]}}}
